description: Create a new Pedra property. Returns its propertyId and an appUrl. To add photos that are on the user's device, pedra_create_upload_link is simpler (no login); or give the user the appUrl to open the property in Pedra and drop their photos in, then use pedra_list_property_images.

name.description: Property name, e.g. the listing address.

name: pedra_create_property
title: Create property
